from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import sys

class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_result = False
        self.in_h2 = False
        self.in_cite = False
        self.in_p = False
        self.depth = 0
        self.href = None
        self.title = []
        self.cite = []
        self.desc = []
        self.results = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'li' and 'b_algo' in a.get('class','').split():
            self.in_result = True
            self.depth = 1
            self.href = None
            self.title=[]; self.cite=[]; self.desc=[]
        elif self.in_result:
            self.depth += 1
            if tag == 'h2': self.in_h2 = True
            if tag == 'cite': self.in_cite = True
            if tag == 'p': self.in_p = True
            if tag == 'a' and self.in_h2 and self.href is None:
                self.href = a.get('href')
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if not self.in_result: return
        if tag == 'h2': self.in_h2=False
        if tag == 'cite': self.in_cite=False
        if tag == 'p': self.in_p=False
        self.depth -= 1
        if tag == 'li' and self.depth <= 0:
            self.results.append((self.href,''.join(self.title).strip(),''.join(self.cite).strip(),''.join(self.desc).strip()))
            self.in_result=False
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_h2: self.title.append(data)
        elif self.in_cite: self.cite.append(data)
        elif self.in_p: self.desc.append(data)

for f in sorted(Path(sys.argv[1]).glob('bing_*.html')):
    p=P(); p.feed(f.read_text(errors='ignore'))
    print(f'--- {f.name} ---')
    for i,(href,title,cite,desc) in enumerate(p.results[:10],1):
        print(f'{i}. {title}\\n   {href}\\n   {cite}\\n   {desc}')

/bin/bash -lc 'tmpd=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/great-ganges-altsearch.XXXXXX")
q='"'\"GREAT GANGES INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY\" Gadankhera'
enc="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$q" | jq -sRr @uri)
for spec in '"\\
  'ddg|https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=' \\
  'brave|https://search.brave.com/search?q=' \\
  'yahoo|https://search.yahoo.com/search?p=' \\
  'ecosia|https://www.ecosia.org/search?q=' \\
  'startpage|https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query='; do
  name="'${spec%%|*}
  base=${spec#*|}
  file="$tmpd/$name.html"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$name ---"
  curl --insecure --location --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 -A '"'Mozilla/5.0' \""'$base$enc" -o "$file"
  st=$?
  printf '"'status=%s bytes=' \""'$st"
  wc -c < "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
  rg -n -i -C 2 '"'great ganges|gadankhera|unnao|\\.ac\\.in|\\.edu\\.in|\\.org\\.in' \""'$file" | head -80
done
printf '"'tmpd=%s\\n' \""'$tmpd"'
